name: Phoenix IX
description:
Phoenix IX is a beachfront condo located on the eastern end of Orange Beach near the Alabama–Florida border, offering a quieter stretch of sugar-white sand and convenient access to Orange Beach, Perdido Key, and nearby Gulf Shores. Positioned along miles of scenic shoreline, Phoenix IX provides a relaxed coastal setting with expansive views of both the Gulf of Mexico and the bay.
